templates.name: A place for everything
templates.description: Turn sturdy cardboard, a few tubes, and leftover fabric into a home for your everyday stationery.
steps: Check that the sheets are clean and sturdy; check the tubes and fabric against your design.
Sketch your base and tube positions. Ask an adult for help with difficult cutting.
Cut a base, cover it with fabric, and attach the tubes using suitable craft glue.
Let it dry fully, check the joints, and add your pens. List any usable leftovers.

templates.name: Make your idea stand out
templates.description: Give your school exhibition a thoughtful backdrop using reused board and paper.
steps: Lay out the board and check the dimensions against your display space.
Fold or join panels to make a stable freestanding backdrop.
Plan the order of your information before attaching paper.
Label the sections and check that the display stands securely.

templates.name: A little colour, a new life
templates.description: Make a reusable celebration banner from leftover fabric and string.
templates.already_have: Scissors, ruler, suitable glue or a needle and thread
steps: Check that the fabric is clean and the string is intact.
Make a paper triangle template and trace it onto the fabric.
Cut the shapes and attach them securely to the string.
Hang within easy reach and store the banner for the next celebration.
